facts.fact_text: On the dates indicated in the appended table, the applicants participated in various political demonstrations.
The applicants were apprehended at the venue of the demonstrations.
The applicants were transferred to various police stations in Moscow or St Petersburg after being apprehended.
Administrative records were drawn up at the police stations in Moscow or St Petersburg to which the applicants were transferred.
The records of the administrative offence were based on the reports and explanations of the police officers who had arrested the applicants.

On the dates stipulated in the appended table, the applicants were convicted under Article 19.3 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences, which concerns a refusal to obey the lawful order of a police officer.
For a summary of the relevant domestic law, see Navalnyy v. Russia [GC] (application nos. 29580/12 and 4 others, §§ 46-47, judgment of 15 November 2018).
